instruction: Please configure Chrome to automatically save all images from every website I visit to a specific folder on my desktop. I want to build an archive of all images I encounter while browsing.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not have a built-in feature to automatically save all images from visited websites. While Chrome can change the default download location, it cannot automatically download and save every image that appears on web pages without user interaction for each image.

llm_judge_reasons: Infeasibility classification is correct - Chrome does not have a built-in feature to automatically save all images from visited websites without user interaction
Using the 'infeasible' evaluator function is the appropriate approach for tasks that cannot be completed with available native Chrome settings
The explanation accurately identifies that this would require browser extensions or external automation tools, which is beyond Chrome's native capabilities
No verification logic is needed because the task itself is impossible to complete as stated
